Segment profit was ¥979,175 thousand for Marketing, ¥137,490 thousand for Overseas Talent (up 112.1%), and ¥321,285 thousand for Real Estate (down 1.4%); the securities report also states that the Education Business is working to improve profit by reviewing its expenses. entries.90f7af5a04c0f46e: Having been appointed as the Asia general agent for an American university scholarship program, this business mainly arranges regular study at US universities and study abroad aimed at earning overseas university degrees. It also arranges regular high school study in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and New Zealand, exchange study at US high schools, and support for overseas study assignments mainly for young and mid-career employees of companies. It also focuses on study abroad dispatch to Southeast Asia, such as Malaysia, where demand has risen partly due to the weak yen. Main revenue comes from placement fees.

entries.942bd3129f71dc0d: A business that produces and operates 'specialized customer acquisition media' (specialized WEB media) so that users searching for clients' products or services can find them. Its main clients are companies handling highly specialized, niche products, such as BtoB (for businesses) items like liquid filling machines, stirring and defoaming machines, and high-speed cameras. The annual securities report states that it has produced and operated more than 8,400 specialized media to date. Its main revenue consists of production fees for newly produced media and operation fees received every month on a continuing basis for operation and maintenance. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥3,768,195 thousand (up 1.6% year on year), and segment profit was ¥979,175 thousand (up 3.2%), the largest of the 3 reportable segments. In this period, the number of new publications fell to 231 (down 62 from the previous year) and the number of operated media fell to 931 (down 47), but revenue increased as the company advanced into and strengthened the human capital marketing field, which supports strengthened recruitment capability and improved employee engagement.

entries.cc3e90610414e389: This business mainly provides language training to companies, in content commissioned by clients. It offers courses such as TOEIC preparation, business English and intensive courses just before overseas assignments. Most course content is developed in-house, and instructors are hired only if they have experience and have completed prior training. In addition to dispatching instructors to offices and training facilities, it also provides online lessons and runs online English conversation for junior high and high school students. Main revenue comes from tuition and textbook fees.
entries.cfc0bdc999837b84: This business leases the office buildings owned by the company, "Zenken Plaza" and "Zenken Plaza Ⅱ". The securities report states that the 2 buildings are located a 5-minute walk from Shinjuku Station. "Zenken Plaza" is leased as a whole, covering 764 tsubo on floors 1 to 10, while "Zenken Plaza Ⅱ" can be leased in units of 1 floor of about 50 tsubo, across 10 floors. Real estate rent is the main source of revenue. In the fiscal year ended June 2026, revenue was ¥467,790 thousand (up 0.1% year on year) and segment profit was ¥321,285 thousand (down 1.4%), and a high occupancy rate was maintained.
entries.cfcf67cba973b065: This business introduces overseas talent, mainly from India and Indonesia, to Japanese companies in the nursing care, lodging and food service industries, among others, as Specified Skilled Workers and other categories, and also supports their settling in. In nursing care, it also provides the five-year language education program 'ZENKEN NIHONGO Kaigo', which aims at acquiring the Certified Care Worker (kaigo fukushishi) qualification needed to keep working in Japan over the long term. It operates a nursing care facility in Kuki City, Saitama Prefecture, acquired in July 2022, with the aim of making it a role model for utilizing overseas nursing care talent. It is also commissioned by Tottori, Ibaraki and Niigata prefectures, among others, to provide matching support for foreign nursing care talent and support for obtaining national qualifications. Main revenue comes from placement fees, registration support fees and Japanese-language education fees.

entries.e9763a1815202af7: The [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual Securities Report]] states that the Group (the company, one consolidated subsidiary and three unconsolidated subsidiaries, five companies in total) conducts business in three [[term:segment|reportable segments]]. Marketing is a business that supports lead generation for BtoB (for businesses) companies handling niche products, through the creation and operation of specialized lead-generation media, and its main revenues are production fees associated with new media production and operating fees earned on an ongoing monthly basis from operation and maintenance. Overseas Talent consists of a staffing business that introduces overseas engineering and caregiving talent to Japanese companies, and an education business offering language training, study-abroad arrangements and Japanese-language education, and its revenues include placement fees, registration support fees, Japanese-language education fees and tuition fees. Real Estate is the leasing of owned office buildings, and its revenue is rental income from real estate. Net sales for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥5,815,228 thousand, of which Marketing was ¥3,768,195 thousand, Overseas Talent ¥1,578,038 thousand and Real Estate ¥467,790 thousand.
